name: Feed Subscriber
description: Ports agentic-workspace's Feed Subscriber into aw-workspace: an asyncio poller — one independent task per configured "card" — watches a JSON source URL on its own interval and, when the response changes since the last poll, fires a Webhook Call or an Agent Call (POST /api/agents/{slug}/run on agents-platform) describing what changed. The last polled response and change history per card are exposed read-only through the list_feed_entries MCP tool. Configuration is a component-mode CRUD window (Settings → Feed Subscriber); each card's auth_token is routed to the zero-knowledge secret store, never stored in plain config.

skills.description: What a Feed Subscriber card is, when to configure Webhook Call vs Agent Call, how to read a card's cached state with list_feed_entries, and how to diagnose a feed that stopped firing.

cards.description: Feed subscription cards. Managed through this app's own CRUD routes (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/apps/feed-subscriber/cards), not this raw field — each card's auth_token is stripped before it ever reaches this array and lives in the secret store instead, keyed card:<id>:auth_token. Ported from agentic-workspace's src/config/aw.json -> feed_subscriber.cards.

agents_platform_base.description: Base URL of the agents-platform instance an Agent Call card dispatches to (POST /api/agents/{slug}/run). Same default + reachability rationale as aw-app-agents-platform-runners' own agents_platform_base — 172.18.0.1 is the bridge gateway reachable from this workspace's container; override if your subnet differs.

agents_platform_token.description: Bearer token sent on every Agent Call dispatch and on the agent-picker lookup this app's config UI uses to populate the Agent dropdown. Optional — leave blank if agents-platform on this workspace doesn't require identity auth; required if it does (see aw-app-agents-platform-runners' agents_platform_token for how to mint one).
